request: Analyze GSE200283 for PMID 41663755 (Loss of mechanical stress induces synovitis, fibrosis and articular cartilage degeneration via distinct synovial cell subsets.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Effect of loss of mechanical stress (knee immobilization + tail-suspension unloading, MMS) on synovium gene expression over time (D3/D7/D14 vs control), and its reversal by restored joint motion (R1) or motion + loading (R2). This is a disuse/unloading model, not an exercise intervention; R1/R2 are remobilization/reloading.
planned_contrasts: each MMS time point vs Control (synovium); R1 and R2 vs Control/MMS — shown only as heatmaps/module patterns (S2.3.p1/S2.4.p1, Figs 2-4); no DEG counts reported
gene selection: FC MMS D14/control <0.67 or >1.5 with FPKM>1 -> 1178 genes (S4.8.p2)

paper_threshold.note: fold change >= 2.0 and FDR <= 0.001 (BGI PoissonDis); inclusive on both cutoffs

final.paper_method: BGI PoissonDis on full transcriptome (S4.7.p1); iDEP 0.91 for clustering/PCA on FPKM (S4.8.p1)
final.inclusion: male C57BL/6J; one mouse (both knees pooled) per sample; n=3/group for synovium (S4.7.p1)
final.paper_results: named genes only (synovium: Spp1, Col1a1, Ibsp, Col1a2, Postn, Mmp13, Mmp9, Il1b, Il11, Ccl2, Osm, Lif, Tgfb1, Tgfb3 up; cartilage: Col2a1, Col11a1, Col11a2, Acan, Prg4, Sox9, Sox5 down); no DEG counts

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.7.p1 gives the DEG rule (FC>=2, FDR<=0.001, PoissonDis) but the paper reports no DEG counts; results are heatmaps of modules and named genes (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1). S4.8.p2 states the deposited gene sets were pre-selected by fold change MMS D14/control. The intervention is disuse (S2.1.p1, S4.2.p1), with remobilization R1 and remobilization+reloading R2 (FIG1 c, S2.2.p1).

checks: DA.p1 names GSE200283 for bulk RNA-seq
GEO tissue=synovium samples match the paper's groups and n=3/group
matrix has 1178 genes = the paper's FC-selected count in S4.8.p2

ownership.reasoning: DA.p1 deposits bulk data as GSE200283; matrix row count 1178 equals S4.8.p2.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (cont_RepN, MMSD3_RepN, ...) correspond to GEO titles ('Control synovium rep1'); prep script only renames 'cont_' to 'Control_' (values untouched), key derived from title group+rep, matched ignoring case/separators. No positional alignment. Metadata restricted to this tissue by prep/split_metadata.py (title keys repeat across tissues).

matrix.stop_reason: The only deposited matrix is FPKM for 1178 genes that were PRE-SELECTED by fold change MMS D14 vs control (FPKM>1, FC<0.67 or >1.5; S4.8.p2). Any differential test on it is circular (features chosen on the outcome), is not genome-wide (BH/FDR over a selected subset is invalid), and cannot reproduce the paper's PoissonDis DEG call (needs full read counts). FPKM also cannot feed a count model. In addition the design has no exercise arm: it is a disuse model whose only loading-restoration arms (R1/R2) have no paper-reported DEG result. A genome-wide matrix would require re-processing the SRA reads, which is outside this run.
matrix.reasoning: Values are non-integer (1% integer), min ~0.5-1.0 (consistent with the FPKM>1 filter), GEO data_processing: 'comma-delimited text files include FPKM values'. Row count equals the FC-selected gene counts in S4.8.p2. Excel-date gene IDs present (e.g. 7-Mar/1-Mar), a further sign of a curated spreadsheet rather than a full matrix.

candidates.value: limma on log2(FPKM+1) of the deposited subset
candidates.reason_rejected: gene set selected on the same MMS-vs-control fold change; circular and non-genome-wide FDR

candidates.value: R2 or R1 vs MMS as a 'reloading/exercise-like' contrast
candidates.reason_rejected: same selected-subset problem; paper reports no such DE result; cartilage n=2
